segments.name: Towing and recovery equipment
segments.description: Designs and manufactures bodies of car carriers and wreckers installed on third-party chassis, sold through distributors and directly to customers.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment identified as towing and recovery equipment, which is manufactured in the United States, United Kingdom, Italy, and France.

revenueModel.text: Customers purchase towing and recovery equipment through a network of distributors or directly as end-user customers, with sales also to governmental entities through prime contractors.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products are marketed and sold primarily through a network of distributors that serve all 50 states, Canada, Mexico, and other foreign markets, and through prime contractors to governmental entities.

changes.text: In 2023, the Company acquired substantially all assets of Southern Hydraulic Cylinder, Inc., which manufactures hydraulic cylinders and related components.
changes.evidence: During fiscal 2023, the Company acquired substantially all of the assets and assumed certain liabilities of Southern Hydraulic Cylinder, Inc. through an acquisition subsidiary formed as a Tennessee corporation, which then changed its name to SHC, Inc. ("SHC").

changes.text: In 2025, the Company acquired Omars – S.p.A., a designer and manufacturer of towing and recovery vehicles headquartered in Italy.
changes.evidence: On December 2, 2025, Miller Industries, Inc. acquired Omars – S.p.A ("Omars"), a designer and manufacturer of towing and recovery vehicles, headquartered in Cuneo, Italy.
